candidate_only_overlap_context.identity_status: Proposed context only; no equivalence, join, ratio, normalization or graph bridge

interpretation_limits.NA: Literal NA retained exactly; no missingness equivalence or zero assigned
interpretation_limits.RS_lnRS_regime_BL: Source strings only; no recomputation or biological inference
interpretation_limits.Spawners: README states two years prior, millions; no numerical transformation or cross-source normalization
interpretation_limits.Year: README states return year; no brood-year shift or ontology year binding
interpretation_limits.mean_pH: README describes pCO2 subpolar gyre despite mean_pH header; retained unresolved

local_filename_staging.parser: Existing builtin csv; no custom parser or core/schema/guard changes.
local_filename_staging.reason: Existing Spec schema requires filename tokens without spaces. Original filenames/URLs/bytes remain unchanged.

rights_scope: Record metadata explicitly identifies CC BY 4.0 for the attached files. Source redistribution evidence does not approve science or publish this derived build. Per-output accompanying attribution is emitted outside the genuine build directory. No grant for private AK/DFO/NOAA data is implied.
source_citation: Ohlberger, Jan (2021). Non-stationary and interactive effects of climate and competition on pink salmon productivity. Zenodo, record 5780246. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.5780246. CC BY 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/.

source_descriptions.Escapement: wild PWS pink salmon spawner escapement (millions)
source_descriptions.NPGOann: annual North Pacific Gyre Oscillation index
source_descriptions.Run.Size: wild PWS pink salmon run size, i.e. total return (millions)
source_descriptions.Spawners: wild PWS pink salmon spawners two years prior (millions)
source_descriptions.egoa.spr.sst: eastern Gulf of Alaska spring temperature anomaly
source_descriptions.egoa.win.sst: eastern Gulf of Alaska winter temperature anomaly
source_descriptions.prevYearRunSize: wild PWS pink salmon previous year run size (millions)
source_descriptions.prev_tot_PWS_return: previous year return wild plus hatchery fish (millions)
source_descriptions.sameYrcomp_regional: regional sockeye plus chum salmon abundance (millions)
source_descriptions.sameYrcompetitors: NE Pacific sockeye plus chum salmon abundance (millions)
source_descriptions.wgoa.spr.sst: western Gulf of Alaska spring temperature anomaly
source_descriptions.wgoa.win.sst: western Gulf of Alaska winter temperature anomaly

source_grid.encoding: UTF-8 with BOM; builtin csv reads utf-8-sig

source_vs_build_version.build_date: Explicit execution input; not a source release, observation or retrieval date
source_vs_build_version.derivation: lexical- plus first 12 hexadecimal characters of original CSV SHA256
